mapper.select: SELECT TASK_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_DESC, TASK_TYPE, ENABLE_FLAG, PREDECESSORS, PVALUE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM TASK_DEFINITIONS WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}

SELECT TASK_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_DESC, TASK_TYPE, ENABLE_FLAG, PREDECESSORS, PVALUE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM TASK_DEFINITIONS WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId} ORDER BY TASK_ID

SELECT TASK_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_DESC, TASK_TYPE, ENABLE_FLAG, PREDECESSORS, PVALUE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM TASK_DEFINITIONS WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId} AND TASK_NAME = #{taskName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TASK_DEFINITIONS ( TASK_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TASK_NAME, TASK_DESC, TASK_TYPE, ENABLE_FLAG, PREDECESSORS, PVALUE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{workflowId}, #{taskName}, #{taskDesc}, #{taskType}, #{enableFlag}, #{predecessors}, #{pvalue}, #{createdBy}, #{creationDate}, #{lastUpdatedBy}, #{lastUpdateDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TASK_DEFINITIONS SET TASK_NAME = #{taskName}, TASK_DESC = #{taskDesc}, TASK_TYPE = #{taskType}, ENABLE_FLAG = #{enableFlag}, PVALUE = #{pvalue}, LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{lastUpdatedBy}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = #{lastUpdateDate} WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
